title: Present successful task stderr without error styling
description:
Improve task-output presentation so completed tasks can show captured stderr as runtime diagnostics without red error styling. Reserve error styling for failed tasks or a terminal task error message. Preserve separate stdout and stderr streams for troubleshooting.

Out of scope: changing process stream routing or suppressing runtime logs.
right_now_summary: Completed tasks should show stderr as diagnostics without red styling unless the task fails.
